evidence.scope: Only synthetic RawInfoDocument construction, pure diagnostic rank analogue, native _rank_documents/_select_required_source_documents/_retrieval_contract_coverage. No Store/model/Signal execution/GET/labels/source append/fullprepare.

candidate_definition: Diagnostic document ordering (-whole-word distinct query coverage,-sum capped token frequency at3,-available_at,document_id), then unchanged native required selector capped10. It is not installed production source ranking, and structured projection searchable metadata differ from document-body search.
observations: Long-old repeated query words exclude latest real facts in native substring rank; cap3/tie availability candidate recovers latest in the fixed repetition control.

With four semantically required sources and eight same-query newer irrelevant sources, candidate omits older comparable and currency witness although a four-document sufficient subset fits cap10. Native required selector still reports its declared source+two-period contract satisfied.
Adding one newer same-query irrelevant source additionally removes necessary same-period conflict witness. Distinct whole words and cap3 do not make new irrelevant harmless.

Eleven same-query/same-date currency alternatives tie on lexical score: ID order omits USD. A query that specifies neither unit nor reporting currency cannot guarantee the intended basis; a different intended currency has identical retrieval inputs.

Ten newer lexically relevant source-format alternatives exclude the older skill-readable format. A version-specific skill constraint cannot be inferred safely from relevance/recency alone. This is a synthetic format capability example, not an observed published-skill model failure.

existing_boundaries.meaning: Existing three-layer catalog/fetch/provenance design and pure APIs expose PIT filtered cards, omission/pagination and exact content-hash/span reads. Reusable plumbing exists; it is not proof of LLMSignal integration.
Reflect _DocumentChannelCaller/provider actually implements catalog/fetch with its own two-exchange limits. Those limits and authority do not automatically apply to LLMSignal.
LLMSignal takes supplied item.documents and visible source_projection only. Same-document exact boundary repair cannot load an unselected document; no catalog/fetch/read actions are accepted here.

Existing pure callback may choose <=10 unchanged members after PIT/source/lookback/dedup. Deterministic callable owns its fact basis; LLM path currently does not use that helper. Required selector knows source groups and generic period/observation counts, not semantic currency/target period/conflicts.

Executor fingerprints selected docs and may skip before runner; it later validates against item.documents. Runner-only new reads would break evidence qualification, actual-source fingerprint and skip semantics.

minimal_options.option: Use already admitted deterministic successor for newly declared numeric run scope
minimal_options.scope: Keeps existing callable-owned semantics and result contract. Do not swap a historical exact v6 freeze, rewrite v1 skill, or call historical input diagnostics current production default. Current v12 work can proceed independently.

Whole-word/capped-frequency relevance and truthful omission visibility can be spec-first repairs on fresh freezes. They reduce lexical artifacts; these fixed counterexamples prohibit claiming semantic basis/coverage guarantee. Do not derive formulas or currency defaults from query prose.

minimal_options.option: Bounded native source reading for active LLM versions, only if that interface is explicitly chosen
minimal_options.scope: Reuse three-layer disclosure and original role/caller; no new ranker agent or default extra LLM layer. Begin with metadata catalog, not ten already disclosed bodies; otherwise fetching an eleventh source silently changes the cap. Same Signal role may request bounded exact reads before returning unchanged canonical SignalResult.

concrete_interface_if_chosen: Executor freezes the eligible immutable pool after issuer/PIT/source/lookback/dedup, and supplies only content-addressed catalog handles. Catalog pages disclose omitted counts; no filesystem paths or future/out-of-scope handles.

Define a single per-Signal bounded read contract: cumulative unique original bodies <=10, total character/request/case limits unchanged, explicit capped paging/fetch exchanges. Do not inherit Reflect exchange count without an owner decision.

Runner read outcomes carry runtime-owned exact consumed document identities back to Executor, separate from canonical SignalResult. Revalidate all fetched IDs/hashes/owner/cutoff; final evidence must be from that Signal actual read set and exact visible lineage.

Persist actual consumed document refs/coverage through existing resolution and returned batch provenance. Compute final actual-source fingerprint from that read set. Before a skip, also verify frozen eligible catalog identity/read-policy and prior read receipts so a newly eligible source cannot be invisible behind unchanged initial ten; do not relabel pool fingerprint as consumed evidence.

Every catalog/read exchange uses existing request journaling/cache/receipt and logical budget accounting. Recovery must reconstruct the same read set before validating result/fingerprint; cache miss cannot fetch freely on completed restore. Accepted siblings retain their own source permissions/results and are not rerun or given each other new documents.

decision_boundary.ordinary: Using pure existing APIs, fixing source-format reads/offsets/omission reporting, implementing agreed caps/guards, and choosing tokenization details do not require users to select implementation details. No research definition is supplied by a rank tweak.
decision_boundary.substantive: Architecture already endorses disclosure, but adding LLMSignal read actions over previously unselected sources changes an active caller interface, per-role source authority, max10 meaning and number of budgeted exchanges/skip-consumer semantics. Prepare one concrete owner proposal under AGENTS before changing it; do not silently widen authority because Reflect has a channel. New unit/comparison/schema policies absent from a version measurement contract are also substantive, not retrieval implementation defaults.

limits: No proposed option implemented. These are small synthetic counterexamples, not independent model/measurement benefit or evidence that every query rank fails.
No changed Registry, schema, source policy, published skill, default version or completed artifact.
No formula parser, automatic currency inference, new numeric LLM execution policy, or full F5/MVP closure.
